title: Overdue payment notice
description: Notify customers of an overdue balance on WhatsApp with the amount, days late and a link to settle. Polite utility template for collections.
notes: Keep the tone neutral and avoid threats or legal wording; Meta rejects aggressive collection copy. Offer a human contact button so customers can negotiate.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, our records show that your payment of *{{amount}}* is {{days_late}} days overdue. You can settle it now or talk to our team to review your options.
